Author: Krishan Pahal
Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:109487
Court No. - 65
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 23841 of 2025
Applicant :- Idrish
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Rafiqa Anees Khan,Saurabh Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Ms. Rafiqa Anees Khan, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sunil Kumar, learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the material placed on record.

3. Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.194 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 323, 304B I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Hapur Dehat, District Hapur, during the pendency of trial.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The informant has been examined as PW-1 during trial and has not supported the prosecution story.

PW-2 is the formal witness and is not eye-witness, as Idrish vs State Of U.P. on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7802955/
1 such, there is no evidence against the applicant.

entities.text: Idrish vs State Of U.P. on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no likelihood of conviction of the applicant in the present case.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has further stated that there is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 15.05.2021 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
6. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application but could not dispute the submissions made by the counsel for the applicant.

7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, the evidence on record, taking into consideration the fact that the informant has not supported the prosecution story and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant- Idrish, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with evidence during trial.
(ii) The applicant shall not pressurise/intimidate with the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed.
9. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

10. It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

Order Date :- 10.7.2025 (Ravi Kant) (Justice Krishan Pahal)
